title: Heart Sutra, Part 2: Avalokiteshvara
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up Avalokiteshvara, the bodhisattva who speaks the Heart Sutra, and opens with a short video of the Theravada monks' Walk for Peace and Red Cedar's own silent walk on Sunday. Nomon then traces the names Guanyin and Kanzeon, tells how Avalokiteshvara's head burst from the world's suffering and was rebuilt with ten faces, and retells the fable of Miao Shan, who gives her eyes and arms to cure her cruel father. Nomon closes by reading John Blofeld's account of a statue of Guanyin in a Chinese monastery answering him: "Seek it with your mind."
